caption:
You're not behind. You're early in something that only pays people who don't quit at month three.

Everyone you're comparing yourself to has a stretch of months they don't post about — the posts that reached 60 people, the ad that burned R$300 and taught them one thing, the DM they rewrote nine times. That part isn't in the highlight reel because nobody screenshots it.

And the numbers are genuinely against you at the start, which is worth knowing so you stop reading it as a verdict on your ability. Average organic reach on Instagram is 3.2%. The platform got tighter for everyone.

What compounds instead: a clearer offer every month, a shorter reply time, a better first three seconds, one more case you can point at.

None of that is visible for a while. Then it's the only thing that is.

Month three is where most people stop. That's the entire competitive advantage, and it's free.

📌 DM me the word AUDIT and I'll send you the 20-minute version, or grab it from the link in my bio.
